name: relative-time
title: Relative time
description: A time element that reads '5 minutes ago', keeps itself current without ticking, and shows the exact date, time and zone in a tooltip.
docs: value is the moment (a Date, an ISO string or a timestamp). The words are cut, never rounded up: 59 minutes never reads 1 hour, and yesterday is the previous calendar day in timeZone, not 24 hours ago. After threshold days (default 7; Infinity never, 0 always) the words give way to a date written by format (short, medium, long, datetime, or your own Intl options). The text is rewritten at the moments it changes, with one timer that waits for the next change instead of ticking; updateEvery (seconds, default 60) is the longest it goes without a check and 0 reads the clock once. Nothing runs while the tab is hidden and nothing is announced. now pins the clock for tests, previews and words in server HTML; without it the server and the first paint write the date with its year and the words take over once the browser's clock is known. The exact moment sits in datetime, in a tooltip that hover, tap and (with focusable) keyboard focus open, and in text for screen readers; tooltip={false} leaves it in the title. justNow words a time under a minute. relative-time/format exports the same functions (relativeText, dateText, exactText) for a Server Component.
